# Giriraaj Textiles

## Overview
Giriraaj Textiles is a yarn manufacturer in Beawar, Rajasthan (Ajmer region), established in 2025. Proprietorship led by S Agarwal. Up to 10 employees. GST registered in 2025.

## Products
- Recycled polyester spun yarn: 3-ply, English cotton count Ne 12/3 (coarser) and Ne 15/3 (finer). Colours include white, cream, snow white, blue, red, yellow, black.
- Polypropylene plastic bag closing thread for industrial sack closing.

## Typical use
Closing and stitching woven PP, jute, paper, and mesh bags for grain, feed, seed, fertiliser, cement, and other bulk packing.
